messages.subject: Memory and parallel computing
parts:
Hello,

I'd like to ask a question about a memory issue. I cannot post a reply on the thread https://groups.google.com/g/nimble-users/c/mwU3rxMf6jQ/m/BUmK6ne5AQAJ, because my reply is always deleted automatically after I posted...

I am interested in knowing how to delete redundant memory in parallel computing. I ran 50 chains in parallel by foreach function. When it returns the 50 summary objects (each only costs a little memory), I found the main R session received a lot of memory than expected. I saw each session only occupied around 1 GB. The foreach function seems to return much redundant memory from each R session (I'm not sure). I wonder whether there is any example of memory saving and parallel computing. I saw there is a "system2() + Rscript" approach on that thread, but I wonder how to do it in an example.

Thanks a lot!
Keith
